clue.text: Retired? Losing job, if going on strike

indicators.note: one piece is said to go on after the other, so it is placed second

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a person sacked from a job and joining a strike has effectively retired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired?' with its question mark is the definition: to retire to bed is a fanciful sense of retired.
explanation.definitionFit: To hit the sack is informal for going to bed, and retiring is the polite word for the same thing.
